candidates.title: Theme vars must bind :root color/background
candidates.content: When defining theme tokens via CSS custom properties on `:root`, never set literal `color`/`background` on the root element itself. Bind them to the vars (`color: var(--text); background: var(--canvas)`). Otherwise elements lacking an explicit color (headings, strong, lists) silently inherit the base theme's value and become invisible in alternate themes — light canvas + near-white text. Verify by rendering every theme, not just the default.

candidates.title: Bilingual console: internal IDs need a display-label layer
candidates.content: In a bilingual (EN/ZH) console, every user-visible string must route through the dictionary: nav/section names, panel titles, confirm dialogs, enum values (theme, readiness), button busy labels. Keep internal IDs stable in English and map them through a display-label layer (e.g. `label[section]`, `title` prop), so routing logic and presentation stay decoupled.
